caption: Lightner v. 1621 Route 22 West Operating Co.
citation_line: Lightner v. 1621 Route 22 West Operating Co., Nos. 3:11-cv-02007, 3:11-cv-03960 & 3:11-cv-04072; appeal dismissed, Nos. 12-2122 & 12-2726 (3d Cir. Sept. 4, 2013)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Cooper issued a 129-page decision granting in part an NLRB petition for interim relief under NLRA § 10(j), enjoining interference with union activity and directing reinstatement of two discharged employees while declining other requested relief.
qualification_rationale: The order had concrete labor-relations consequences and illustrates fact-intensive § 10(j) administration. It is supplemental because later NLRB action mooted the appeal and prevented lasting precedential effect.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit dismissed the cross-appeals as moot and vacated the district opinion and order under Munsingwear principles after the NLRB decided the underlying administrative case.
